items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-09-06
items.q: The interviewee refers to 'Captain' as a title or generic role ('the captain went up the river', 'get that captain out of the jam') and mentions specific named captains (Captain T.G. Low, Captain 1900) but does not establish a personal, direct relationship with a specific individual named 'Captain'

ctx.x: Yeah I saw him. Uh huh. He was just a right young looking boy. He was married about 19 years old. He led it. Uh huh. He had goo-goo in the mountains. And General Funston made up a trick on him. And we was in the 100 miles when they caught him. We was hunting him. The sound was up there to hunt him. And we was in the 100 miles on the captain. Captain 1900. General Funston. And he got a promotion from a captain to Brigadier General. I don't know where he is now. I guess he did. He's the man captain of Agalte. So…

items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-09-06
items.q: The only man started that. Was Captain T.G. Low. He was the man that started that water cure... It was Captain Low. The great captain over there.

ctx.x: You know what they do? Like they captured a couple of Filipinas. They got a camp out there in the mountains somewhere. And if they didn't tell. What that camp was. They stick their head in the water. And let them half down. And then pull them out. And then he wouldn't tell. The people won't talk. They won't tell on one another. That is called the water cure. They stick them at. They take them. And they stick their head down in the water. Until they strangled. And then jerk them out. And if they tell them. They…
